description: Bitcoin large transactions in the latest block from mempool.space: total output in BTC, fee, txid and block height, filtered by minBtc. Bitcoin only (no ETH or SOL). Covers the first 25 transactions of the tip block; output total includes change, so it is transaction size, not one wallet's transfer. Price: $0.002 in USDC per successful call, paid with x402 (Base, Solana or Arc); failed calls are not charged.

limit.description: How many transactions to return, 1 to 25 (default 10)

minBtc.description: Minimum total output in BTC, 0.01 to 10000 (default 1)
